policy: Commercial launch readiness is advisory and company-scoped. All monetary assumptions must be explicitly supplied by the company. Titan may calculate arithmetic from those inputs but must not invent revenue, costs, prices, demand, budgets or spending authority.

rules.break_even: ceil((setup_cost + pilot_cost + monthly_fixed_cost) / (expected_job_revenue - expected_job_variable_cost)) when all required inputs are explicitly supplied and contribution margin is positive
rules.budget_warning: known launch investment exceeds explicitly supplied launch_budget_cap
